title: Resolution to grant tax break for affordable housing in Queens
summary: This resolution approves a property tax exemption for a housing development at Block 12334, Lot 273 in Queens, operated by WFHA St. Albans LLC and Albans Housing Development Fund Corporation. The exemption begins July 1, 2020 and continues until HPD and the owner sign a regulatory agreement setting rules for the property. The exemption can end early if the owner fails to meet affordable housing requirements.
